provenance.note: PIB/CBDT FAQ on the capital-gains regime introduced by Finance (No.2) Act 2024, effective for transfers on/after 23 July 2024 — the anchor for equity/property rates and thresholds in this pack, confirmed unchanged through Budget 2026 (https://www.angelone.in/news/taxation/union-budget-2026-ltcg-tax-unchanged-at-12-5-stt-on-commodity-futures-hiked). Section numbers below follow the Income-tax Act, 1961 for FY2025-26 and the Income-tax Act, 2025 (in force from 1 April 2026) for FY2026-27 — see citations for the renumbering source.

equity.actSections.note: FY2026-27 is governed by the Income-tax Act, 2025 (in force from 1 April 2026): STCG under new Section 196 (was 111A), LTCG under new Section 198 (was 112A). Section index corroborated via a compiled statute index (https://a2ztaxcorp.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/IT_Act_2025_with_index.pdf) — titles/index confirmed, not the bare section text itself.

debtFunds.note: Post-1-April-2023 units: entire gain taxed as STCG at slab rate regardless of holding period (Finance Act 2023). Pre-1-April-2023 ('grandfathered') units: LTCG at 12.5% WITHOUT indexation if held >24 months (indexation was removed for this category too by Budget 2024) — corrects an earlier assumption that grandfathered units retained indexation.

property.transitionalOption.note: Resident individuals/HUFs selling land or a building acquired before 23 July 2024 may choose the lower of 12.5% (no indexation) or 20% (with indexation). Tied to acquisition date, not sale year — CBDT is still notifying the Cost Inflation Index for FY2026-27 (CII=384, Notification 85/2026) specifically because this group still needs it, which is the best available confirmation the option has no sunset yet. The exact statutory proviso text (India Code/egazette) was not independently pulled — this rests on consistent secondary-source reporting.

reit.note: Budget 2025 amended Section 115UA (now recast under the 2025 Act) to explicitly bring in Section 112A/198 alongside 111A/112 (196/197) for business-trust unit gains — read as extending the ₹1.25L annual LTCG exemption to REIT/InvIT units from FY2026-27 (AY2027-28) onward. Moderate confidence: the source's own effective-date wording is internally inconsistent (states 'AY 2026-27' while describing an April-2026 commencement), so the FY2026-27 attribution is this pack's best-supported reading, not a directly quoted effective date — flagged for confirmation against the Finance Act 2025 bare text. Separately, the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Act 2026 (assent 17 Aug 2026, deemed effective 1 Apr 2026) exempts the REIT/InvIT *dividend* distribution component from unit-holder tax regardless of the SPV's regime election (raising the SPV-level surcharge to 25% instead) — a distribution-mechanics change for the Phase 3 REIT Position model, not a capital-gains-rate change, so not encoded in this pack's rules.

section54EC.eligibleBonds.note: CBDT Notification No. 31/2025 [S.O. 1644(E)], 7 April 2025, added HUDCO bonds issued on/after 1 April 2025 (5-year redemption) alongside the pre-existing NHAI/REC/PFC/IRFC bonds. Continuity into new-Act Section 85 for FY2026-27 is inferred (no contrary evidence found), not directly confirmed.
